atoms.b: Sometimes changes occur in an ecosystem. Some common changes are ((++diseases robots)) and ((++natural_disasters witches)). Forest fires are another cause of a sudden change in the ((++environment ocean)). Although forest fires support ((++renewal tigers)) in an ecosystem, they can cause a lot of harm too and can ((++drastically barely)) affect the food web.

atoms.a: There was a forest fire in this habitat which burnt down all the nut trees. Could this affect the food web?

instruction.text: Listen and select the correct answer.

atoms.a: How could the burnt down nut trees disrupt the food web?

b.sound: Less nut trees would mean fewer nuts for the animals that eat them.
The burnt down nut trees would allow all types of animals to gather together.

atoms.a: Animals like birds and squirrels play an important role in spreading seeds from plants. What could happen if these animals left the area due to a lack of food?

b.sound: Seeds from plants would be spread less, and fewer plants would grow.
Plants would have to hope that it’s windy enough for their seeds to be spread.

end.text: If animals that spread seeds from plants were to leave, it would be much harder for the food web to come back into balance.

atoms.b: The ((--producers ++consumers)) would lose an important food source if a forest fire were to burn down all the nut trees. They would have to eat ((++more --less)) of something else in the food web.

In this example, if the fox couldn’t ((++consume --produce)) the nuts anymore, it would have to eat more squirrels. When consumers have to eat more of something else in the ((++food_web --consumer)), the ecosystem is disrupted.

atoms.a: The forest fire was also in the bear’s habitat. Bears consume both mammals and plants, including the animals that survive by eating nuts. Because of the forest fire, they would need to...
b: ++move to a safe space and look for food there.
try to get energy from the Sun.

wrong.text: Bears are consumers, not producers, which is why they cannot directly get their energy from the Sun.

atoms.a: There would now be more competition for food in a smaller area. How could this competition with other consumers affect the food web?
b: Bears would have all the plants and animals to themselves.
++There may not be enough plants and animals for all the bears to consume.
++As the bigger and stronger animals, the bears would take most of the food, and the foxes would suffer.

finish.text: If bears had to share the food source with other consumers, the increased competition would disrupt the food web.
